verdict.rationale: The Graph `driveitem-list-versions` API page shows file revisions can be listed programmatically. It also notes that OneDrive/SharePoint can be configured to retain history, with versions created per edit, per save, manually, or never. The evidence does not show a restore-version endpoint or any concrete retention-window durations, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented API restore of a prior version, specific documented retention windows/limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of version listing via the API.
